selectedFailureDoctor.boundary: Orca does not automatically adopt this harness in every plain session. It is opt-in through orca-team or an explicit user request.

notes: Interactive OpenCode has no --model flag and Orca rejects --effort for OpenCode at launch.
The wrapper sets OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT for this private standalone OpenCode process so the build agent uses opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash#high.
After worker-start, verify the actual session message model with: orca-team verify-session --session <id>.
No worker-start retry is automatic; uncertain starts are recorded with Orca recovery commands.
